mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(asset_id) FROM ASSET WHERE is_deleted = 'N'
SELECT COUNT(asset_id) FROM ASSET WHERE status = #{status} AND is_deleted = 'N'

SELECT CASE WHEN category = 'TRACTOR' THEN '트랙터' WHEN category = 'COMBINE' THEN '콤바인' WHEN category = 'RICE_PLANT' THEN '이앙기' WHEN category = 'TRANSPORT' THEN '운반차' WHEN category = 'LOADER' THEN '로더' ELSE category END as category, COUNT(*) as totalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'MAINTENANCE_REQUIRED' THEN 1 END) as maintenanceRequiredCount FROM ASSET WHERE is_deleted = 'N' AND category IN ('트랙터', '콤바인', '이앙기', '운반차', '로더') GROUP BY category ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
SELECT DISTINCT category FROM ASSET WHERE is_deleted = 'N' ORDER BY category

SELECT category, modelName, modelCount FROM ( SELECT category, name as modelName, COUNT(*) as modelCount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) as rn FROM ASSET WHERE is_deleted = 'N' AND category IN ('트랙터', '콤바인', '이앙기', '운반차', '로더') GROUP BY category, name ) WHERE rn < 8 ORDER BY category, modelCount DESC
SELECT DISTINCT address FROM RESERVATION ORDER BY address
